presets.name: context7
presets.description: Current, version-specific library documentation for coding tasks.
presets.warning: An optional Context7 API key increases limits and can access private sources configured in that account.

presets.name: github
presets.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, and Actions context.
presets.warning: GitHub access follows the account and repositories approved during sign-in.

presets.name: sentry
presets.description: Investigate application errors, traces, releases, and project health.
presets.warning: Sentry can expose production error data. Scope the connection to only the organizations and projects needed.

presets.name: supabase
presets.description: Read-only database, schema, logs, and project development context.
presets.warning: The preset is project-scoped and read-only. Supabase recommends development or test projects rather than production data.

presets.name: openai-docs
presets.description: Official OpenAI developer documentation and API references.
presets.warning: This read-only server retrieves public OpenAI documentation.
